# Nigeria Tops Africa Startup Funding at $635M [2026]
## Nigeria Startup Funding Versus 2025: 2.6 Times the Money
Nigerian startups raised $247 million in January through September 2025 and $635 million in the same window of 2026. That is an increase of $388 million, or about 157%. [Nairametrics framed the result](https://nairametrics.com/2026/10/21/nigeria-reclaims-africas-startup-funding-lead-as-investments-rise-to-635-million/) as a rise in investment to $635 million, and several other Nigerian outlets used near-identical language on October 21.

| Metric (Jan-Sep) | 2025 | 2026 | Change |
|-|-|-|-|
| Funding raised by Nigerian startups | $247 million | $635 million | 2.6x (about +157%) |
| Ventures raising $100K or more | 70 | 77 | +7 (+10%) |
| Average raised per venture (derived) | about $3.5 million | about $8.2 million | about 2.3x |
| Funding added year over year | n/a | $388 million | n/a |
| Position among African markets | Not first | First | First lead since 2022 |

## Egypt Closes In: $445 Million in Second Place
| Group (Jan-Sep 2026) | Amount raised | Share of Africa total (derived) |
|-|-|-|
| All African startups | about $2.16 billion | 100% |
| Nigeria | $635 million | about 29.4% |
| Egypt | $445 million | about 20.6% |
| Nigeria and Egypt combined | $1.08 billion | 50.0% |
| Moove, Flutterwave, Jumia, Yellow Card combined | $440 million | about 20.4% |
| Rest of Nigeria (73 ventures) | about $195 million | about 9.0% |
| All other markets and pan-African ventures | about $1.08 billion | 50.0% |

## Africa’s $2.16 Billion Total and the Wider Funding Climate
African startups collectively raised approximately **$2.16 billion** between January and September 2026. Nigeria’s $635 million is a strong result inside a continental total that is large but not explosive.

Compare Nigeria’s total with the [$90 million seed round for a robot foundation-model startup](https://shattered.io/dream-labs-90m-seed-robot-foundation-model-2026/), which by itself represents about 14% of everything Nigerian startups raised in nine months.

That context frames Nigeria’s result.

## FAQ: Nigeria Startup Funding in 2026
### How much did Nigerian startups raise in the first nine months of 2026?
Nigerian startups raised $635 million between January and September 2026, according to Africa: The Big Deal data cited by Nigerian and African outlets. Reports published on October 21 gave the figure.

### How does that compare with 2025?
The 2026 total is 2.6 times the $247 million raised in the same period of 2025. The number of ventures raising at least $100,000 rose from 70 to 77.

### How much did all of Africa raise?
African startups collectively raised approximately $2.16 billion between January and September 2026. Nigeria and Egypt together account for $1.08 billion, or half of that total.

### What does the funding mean for software developers?
The reports reviewed do not give a separate funding figure for African developer-tools startups, so any such number should be treated as unverified.

### What does Africa: The Big Deal track?
The tracker monitors African startups that raise at least $100,000.
